name: A4
mesh_airframe: McDonnell Douglas A-4E/F/G/H/K Skyhawk (the owner's FSX / P3D freeware package, converted locally; never committed)

license.unavailable: the owner's A-4E/F/G/H/K freeware package (FSX v1.02, P3D v4 v1.03, paint kit) lives on the owner's machine; its readme / licence text has not been read here, and its models are compiled FSX / P3D .mdl files the converter does not read yet. Section 3.3 forbids rendering unattributed geometry, so this airframe stays physics-only until the licence is on disk and an OBJ / FBX export of the model is converted.

dimensions_m.source: [unverified here] published A-4F overall length 40 ft 3 in (12.27 m) and height 15 ft (4.57 m), from memory of the type's standard characteristics; span is taken from the flown FDM's own <wingspan>

nose.source: the FDM's structural origin taken as the nose tip (Aeromatic v0.9, which generated A4.xml, references its stations from the nose); z at the CG waterline

tail.source: nose tip + the type's overall length 12.27 m [unverified here] at the CG waterline

limits.note: A4.xml is an Aeromatic v0.9 model 'created using publicly available data, publicly available technical reports, textbooks, and guesses' (its own file header): unvalidated, so every limit monitored against it would be graded on a guessed airframe.
